name: doctor
summary: Report installed, configured and observed capability separately.
refuses: reporting a configured capability as observed

name: install
summary: Show the change set, then apply it with backups.

name: uninstall
summary: Remove only owned artifacts and settings.

name: open
refuses: registering a project root that was not chosen

name: run
summary: Create an idempotent run from an authorized local file.
refuses: reading a file outside the authorized root

name: pause
summary: Stop new work and attempt controlled interruption.

name: resume
refuses: inventing progress that was not recorded

name: cancel
refuses: reporting a process tree as dead without checking

name: status
summary: Structured status, pending authority and readiness tier.

name: verify
summary: Request the protected checks for a candidate.

name: export-evidence
summary: Export signed records with secrets redacted.
refuses: exporting under an active retention lock without saying so

name: rollback
summary: Restore a compatible version, or execute an authorized deployment recovery.
refuses: rolling back across an irreversible migration
